'''Dug Derby''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] track on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. This course was the third race in the [[Semipro Podracing Circuit]]. [[Ebe E. Endocott/Legends|Ebe Endocott]] is said to have mastered this course. [[Kam Nale|Elan Mak]] held the role of track favorite, however.
